title: Nerve fibers connecting the brain's two hemispheres, by pathway (millions)

source.name: Neuroanatomy of interhemispheric commissures
source.publisher: Standard neuroanatomy literature (corpus callosum axon-count estimates)

notes: The corpus callosum, the brain's largest white-matter tract, is well established at roughly 200 million axons connecting the two hemispheres. The anterior commissure figure is a much smaller secondary pathway; its exact axon count varies by source, so it is marked Illustrative here.
